name: Warlock - Symbiotic Host
description: Refocusing the Warlock from a backline summoner into a shape-shifting, demonic hybrid. You no longer fight alongside your demon; instead, you absorb it as an equippable power matrix, merging with its essence to gain an entirely new suite of physical capabilities.

bonuses.text: Purge Host now also fears all enemies within 8 yards for 3 seconds.

items.name: Flesh-Pact Girdle
items.stats:
+110 Stamina
+95 Intellect
Equip: Unlocks Demonic Synthesis. Absorbing a Voidwalker grants plate-level armor and melee cleaves. Absorbing an Imp grants rapid-fire mobility spells. Absorbing a Felhunter grants magic immunity and silences.
items.flavor: The cold-iron clasps barely contain the void within.

origin.details: Drops from a demonic lieutenant in a mid-tier dungeon.

catalyst.details: Replace the corrupted leather with purified hide, then forge cold-iron clasps to prevent demonic energy leaks.

items.name: Flesh-Pact Mantle
items.stats:
+125 Stamina
+100 Intellect
Equip: Alters Life Tap. Instead of draining health for mana, it rapidly drains mana to temporarily halt the lethal health-drain of the Symbiotic state.
items.flavor: Stitched with silver thread so it cannot feed on its master.

origin.details: A rare drop from an elite demon roaming an endgame corrupted zone.

catalyst.details: Brew a powerful sedative to put the living fabric to sleep, then stitch it closed with silver thread.

items.name: Cleansed Pact-Breaker's Sickle
items.stats:
+160 Stamina
+140 Intellect
Equip: Unlocks Purge Host. Instantly ends Demonic Synthesis, violently ejecting the demon from your body to cause a massive AoE shadow explosion.
items.flavor: Tempered in holy water to direct its explosive malice strictly outward.

origin.details: A guaranteed drop from a high-ranking dreadlord raid boss.

catalyst.details: Re-temper the cursed blade in holy water, and bind the hilt with outward-facing warding runes.
